project.name: youtube-analytics
project.summary: Legacy Python 2 scripts scrape channel video IDs into SQLite and request OAuth-authorized per-video analytics; two additional files are unfinished drafts, not usable entrypoints.

nodes.label: Video ID scraping
nodes.summary: Requests the legacy uploads feed and extracts IDs into a SQLite table.

nodes.label: OAuth analytics reporting
nodes.summary: Reads stored video IDs, requests report metrics and prints results.

nodes.label: Unfinished report experiments
nodes.summary: Two incomplete Python scripts cannot be treated as working alternate flows.

nodes.label: Local SQLite handoff
nodes.summary: ytVideoId.db is runtime data shared between collection and reporting; no database bytes are included.

nodes.label: Legacy feeds and Google APIs
nodes.summary: Remote feeds and OAuth-authorized YouTube APIs are outside this repository.

flows.title: From collected IDs to printed analytics

steps.note: Prompt for a channel and scrape paginated legacy feed HTML for IDs.
Store IDs in the videos table and commit before the separate reporting script runs.
Load local IDs and read separately supplied OAuth client configuration.
Request a report for each video with selected dates, metrics and dimensions.
Print column headers and row values to standard output, not a CSV file.

tour.title: Historical source, not a working-service claim
tour.note: These scripts use Python 2 syntax and historical feed/API versions. No interpreter, network request, OAuth flow or database was executed.

tour.title: Keep incomplete files visible
tour.note: fweeks.py ends with an incomplete with statement; video_picker.py has an unfinished loop and report calls before definitions. They remain fully admitted source and explicitly described drafts.

tour.title: The handoff is a local database
tour.note: Collection and reporting do not import each other. They communicate through a SQLite filename and table; reporting prints values, even though csv is imported.
